g.title: G
g.text: Operational schemas (Supabase PostgreSQL) — the ETL sources
Two designs for the same business. Struck-through columns (21) are excluded by the ETL (see etl_column_exclusions).
PK primary key · FK foreign key · UK unique · ||—o< one to zero-or-many · ||—|< one to one-or-many · ✗ ETL = column left out of the warehouse
